programs.title: Premier League Stories

programs.description: From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: John Stones
programs.description: John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Granit Xhaka
programs.description: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Roberto Mancini
programs.description: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: The Evolution of Goalkeepers

programs.title: Premier League Stories
